newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Five killed in Bangladesh factory stampede.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Bangladesh factory stampede.

text.p: At least five people were killed and more than 20 injured in a stampede at a garment factory in Dhaka on Wednesday, police and witnesses said.
They said the stampede occurred after an electric short circuit at the Shanghai Apparels factory.
"Workers at the factory started running down narrow stairs causing extreme suffocation and many also jumped from fourth floor windows," one fire brigade officer said.
"They thought the factory would be on fire after the short circuit," he said.
All the five dead were women, doctors at Dhaka Medical College Hospital told reporters. Some of the injured were in critical condition, they said.
Police said the workers panicked because eight people had been killed in another garment factory fire on July 16 in the capital.
